description: This file defines the Candidate entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, including properties, ORM mapping, and basic getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Candidate
classes.description: Represents a job candidate, including personal details and associations with vacancies, attachments, and history.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the candidate.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the candidate.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the candidate.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name of the candidate.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the middle name of the candidate, if any.

methods.name: setMiddleName
methods.description: Sets the middle name of the candidate.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the candidate.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name of the candidate.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the candidate.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the candidate.

methods.name: getContactNumber
methods.description: Returns the contact number, if any.

methods.name: setContactNumber
methods.description: Sets the contact number.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the candidate status (deprecated).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the candidate status (deprecated).

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comment associated with the candidate.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the candidate.

methods.name: getModeOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the mode of application (manual or online).

methods.name: setModeOfApplication
methods.description: Sets the mode of application.

methods.name: getDateOfApplication
methods.description: Returns the date when the application was made.

methods.name: setDateOfApplication
methods.description: Sets the date of application.

methods.name: getCvFileId
methods.description: Returns the CV file ID (deprecated).

methods.name: setCvFileId
methods.description: Sets the CV file ID (deprecated).

methods.name: getCvTextVersion
methods.description: Returns the CV text version (deprecated).

methods.name: setCvTextVersion
methods.description: Sets the CV text version (deprecated).

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Returns keywords associated with the candidate.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets keywords for the candidate.

methods.name: getAddedPerson
methods.description: Returns the employee who added the candidate.

methods.name: setAddedPerson
methods.description: Sets the employee who added the candidate.

methods.name: isConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Checks if the candidate has given consent to keep data.

methods.name: setConsentToKeepData
methods.description: Sets the consent to keep data.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Returns the collection of candidate vacancy links.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Returns the collection of candidate attachments.

methods.name: getCandidateHistory
methods.description: Returns the collection of candidate history records.
